description: The BEST Directory, Building Energy Software Tools, is a searchable directory of software for building energy work, formerly hosted by the U.S. Department of Energy. Tools can be filtered by capability (whole building energy simulation, load calculations, HVAC sizing, parametrics and optimisation, code compliance, ratings, utility bill and meter analysis, weather and climate analysis, building automation, auditing, benchmarking, monitoring, lighting, air flow, life cycle analysis and solar), by building type and scale from subsystem to urban, by platform, pricing (free, open source, academic or trial), language and date of last update. At the time of reading it listed 207 tools, with ratings, reviews and a comparison feature, and a separate training listing. Coverage: software from many countries. Access: open web directory; registration for contributors. Licence: website content; free to browse. Caveats: entries are supplied by vendors and developers, and the last-update filter shows many listings not updated since the 2010s. Simulation uses are finding and comparing building simulation and analysis tools for a study. Related records: EnergyPlus, OpenStudio and other building models in this catalogue.
